cohort: 104 pregnant patients diagnosed with placenta praevia at Aziz Bhatti Shaheed Hospital NSMC, University of Gujrat, over the period of 2015-2016.
finding: Placenta praevia was found to be a significant cause of fetal mortality and maternal morbidity, with high rates of premature deliveries (55.76%), blood transfusions (65.3%), and cesarean sections (84%).
followup_time: 7 days for babies, 6 weeks for mothers
